---
title: "11_DataCleaning"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
source("00_requirements.R")

anes_raw <- read_csv("anes.csv")

#renaming relevant columns and selecting them to go into cleaned set
anes_cleaned <- anes_raw %>%
  select(
    # outcomes
  vote_pres = V242067,
  vote_house = V242075,
  
  # demographics 
  gender = V241551, 
  hispanic = V241499, 
  race_summary = V241501x, #summary of what they ID as 
  mena_origin = V241502, # (1 = yes, 2 = no; middle eastern race check)
  education_level = V241463, # years of education  
  
  # other relevant variables
  age = V241458x, # their actual age
  party_id = V241221, # democrat, republican, or independent/none
  social_class = V242337 # lower class to upper class range 
  ) %>%
  
  # filtering out missing responses 
  # filtering to dem and rep only
  filter(vote_pres %in% c(1,2)) %>%
  
  # making data readable for easy analysis
  mutate( 
    vote_pres = factor(vote_pres, labels=c('Democrat',"Republican")),
    vote_house = case_when(
      vote_house == 1 ~ "Democrat",
      vote_house == 2 ~ "Republican",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    # gender
    gender = case_when(
      gender == 1 ~ "Man",
      gender == 2 ~ "Woman", 
      gender == 3 ~ "Nonbinary",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    
    # social class coding
    social_class = case_when(
      social_class == 1 ~ "Lower Class",
      social_class == 2 ~ "Working Class",
      social_class == 3 ~ "Middle Class",
      social_class == 4 ~ "Upper Class",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    # age 
    age = case_when(
      age < 0 ~ NA_real_, # if less than 0, then NA (refused to respond)
      TRUE ~ age # leaving everything else 
    ),
    #race
    # coding 1 to 6
    race_code = case_when(
      mena_origin == 1 ~ 5, # mena = 5 (mena = middle eastern/north african)
      race_summary == 1 ~ 1, #white = 1
      race_summary == 2 ~ 2, # black = black 
      race_summary == 4 ~ 3, # hispanic = 3
      race_summary == 3 ~ 4, # asian = 4
      race_summary >= 5 ~ 6, # multi/other = 6
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # labeling 
    race = case_when(
      race_code == 1 ~ "White",
      race_code == 2 ~ "Black",
      race_code == 3 ~ "Hispanic",
      race_code == 4 ~ "Asian",
      race_code == 5 ~ "Middle Eastern/North African",
      race_code == 6 ~ "Multiracial/Other",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    
    race = factor(race, levels = c("White","Black","Hispanic","Asian", "Middle Eastern/North African", "Multiracial/Other")),
    
    #education levels
    education_level = case_when(
      education_level <= 8 ~ "Less than HS",
      education_level == 9 ~ "High School/GED",
      education_level %in% 10:12 ~ "College/Associate",
      education_level >= 13 ~ "Bachelors or Higher",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    education_level = factor(education_level, levels = c("Less than HS", "High School/GED", "College/Associate", "Bachelors or Higher")),
    
    # party identification
    party_id = case_when(
      party_id == 1 ~ "Democrat",
      party_id == 2 ~ "Republican",
      party_id %in% c(0,3) ~ "Independent/None",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
    
  )

# removing hispanic, race summary/code, mena_origin
anes_cleaned <- anes_cleaned %>%
  select(-c(hispanic, race_summary, mena_origin, race_code))
# printing cleaned set and column names (8 columns)
anes_cleaned
colnames(anes_cleaned)
```


```{r}
save.image("12_cleanedElectionData.RData")
  
```
